pages.title: Ferry Location
pages.text: This page follows trade_routes.json#nether_river_ferry, yin_underworld_cluster.json, and secret_realms.json#nether_river_land. The ferry links the Nether River and Yinming as a pocket-dimension and secret-realm entrance in the Netherworld cluster, not as an ordinary overland trade route.

pages.title: Fare and Requirements
pages.text: The corpus defines the transport as ghost_boat with a fare of 30 yin stones, intended for early ghost-path cultivators up through Foundation Establishment. seeking_immortals:yin_stone and the Nether River/Yinming pocket-dimension anchors already exist; actual fare collection and ticket service remain future work.

pages.title: Land of the Nether River
pages.text: The Nether River secret realm requires Foundation Establishment and recommends the ghost-cultivation path or completion of ghost-path quests. Its planned route passes the Ferry, Soul Shore, Nether Hall, and Gatekeeper; rewards include yin materials, ghost methods, Nether River chests, and Yin-Barrier Pills.

pages.title: Risks and Future Work
pages.text: Nether River yin mist reduces yang damage, daylight weakens ghost cultivators, and pure-yang attacks gain power; the region can also mitigate yin-aligned tribulations. Ferry NPCs, yin-stone payment, Soul-Gathering Talismans, ghost rules, quest guidance, and unique terrain and structures are still needed.
